notes.title: Steam CBT #2 – Patch Notes
notes.content:
[p][b]Ahoy, Captains![/b][/p][p]Our upcoming [b]September Playtest[/b] sets sail with a range of improvements and changes across the [b]Steam version[/b]. This Playtest is part of the [b]September Update[/b], bringing content that's nearly on par with what's available on console and mobile.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Here’s what’s changed since our first Closed Beta Test:[/b][/p][p][/p][h2]Progression & Account[/h2][list][*][p][b]Max account level increased to 9.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Auto‑login enabled[/b]: Launch the game and you’ll be signed in automatically.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Gameplay & Modes[/h2][list][*][p][b]Available battle types[/b]: Versus AI, Arcade, Standard, Brawl, Ranked
[i]Note: Some modes listed above may not be available during this Playtest.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b]Quick commands[/b]: Now available in battle.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Commander presets[/b]: Save and recall preferred Commander configurations.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Steam-Specific Features[/h2][list][*][p][b]Steam Deck (experimental support):[/b] The game can now be launched on Steam Deck. UI improvements are planned for future updates.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Enhanced Steam features[/b]:[/p][p]o  Rich presence – see what modes your friends are playing.
o  Recent players – track recent teammates and opponents.
o  Steam timelines – shows sunk ship markers in recorded gameplay.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Settings & UI[/h2][list][*][p] [b]Key binding customization[/b]: Full ability to remap keyboard controls.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Gamepad support[/b]: Early-stage support available for Port and in-battle modes.
[i]More improvements will come in the future.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b]Advanced graphics options[/b]: Including HDR, ray tracing, and display monitor selection.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Scroll system overhaul[/b]: Smoother and more responsive UI scrolling.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Nickname change[/b]: Editable from the Settings menu.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Service record screen[/b]: Fully implemented and accessible.[/p][/*][*][p][b]UI enhancements[/b]: Improved clarity and responsiveness for Close/Back buttons.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Communication & Social[/h2][list][*][p][b]Voice chat[/b]: Fully enabled for supported game modes (Division and all battle types).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Notifications[/b]: In-game alerts and messages are fully functional.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Store[/h2][list][*][p][b]Bundles[/b]: Random and chained bundles are now functional.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Other[/h2][list][*][p]Improved Close/Back button visibility and behavior.[/p][/*][*][p]Social links added to menu/Port.[/p][/*][*][p]Loadout and Commander usability improvements.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p][b]Add Legends to your Steam Wishlist—your support fuels our journey![/b][/p]
